name: WS S9 Max Smartwatch
subtitle: 45mm AMOLED Bluetooth Calling Watch
description: The WS S9 Max is a 45mm smartwatch with a 2.1-inch HD display, Bluetooth calling, touch controls, notifications, and wireless charging. It also supports activity, sports, sleep, and heart-rate monitoring functions, giving everyday smartphone users useful features directly on the wrist.
story: Built around a large square display and side crown-style control, the WS S9 Max is designed for everyday communication and routine tracking. Pair it through the Fere Fit app to access supported smart features from a compatible phone. Bluetooth calling, notifications, music control, camera control, voice assistant access, sports registration, and activity data add practical functionality. The watch uses induction charging and has a 260mAh battery. Available colours listed for this model include black, silver, and gold.

specs.notifications: Calls, messages and supported app alerts
specs.activity_features: Activity data and daily movement tracking

shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
